rationale: The exploit-leaning batch produced a strong 7.739 mean and 21 new scaffolds without replacing the exceptional 10.600 incumbent. The predicted maximum has risen to 9.070 as uncertainty narrows, supporting one additional exploit slot while retaining exploration.
expected_outcome: At least 10 compounds in the batch will exceed affinity 8.0, and at least 10 selected scaffolds will be new.
